mission: PROBE-ONLY reconnaissance of water / wastewater / electric line availability. No rail assumed. No store writes. No cell proposals. No hostname synthesis.

utility_adaptations.NO-ZONING-AUTHORITY: rarely fits utilities; do not force
utility_adaptations.ORDINANCE-NO-GIS: provider requires service letter / no public GIS (honest terminal)
utility_adaptations.AUTH-WALLED: utility GIS exists behind login/agreement/CEII (expected common)
utility_adaptations.HOST-BROKEN: catalogue host down or Application Error
utility_adaptations.NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY: catalogue hosts probed, no positive line/CCN layer determination yet
utility_adaptations.LAYER-FOUND: queryable public layer verified by groupBy AND corner probe

additions_allowed: SERVICE-LETTER-REQUIRED — positive determination that public GIS is absent and the honest product answer is a provider service-availability letter (maps onto ORDINANCE-NO-GIS posture for product copy; record both)

expectations_to_test_not_assume: Water/wastewater posture differs from electric (city/MUD/CCN holder vs utility-owned data)
Utility GIS frequently AUTH-WALLED or agreement-only
Some cities publish mains; almost none publish laterals
SERVICE-LETTER-REQUIRED is a correct and useful product answer
TCEQ/PUCT CCN territory may answer who-serves even when line geometry is withheld
method_rules: Catalogue-driven hosts only — never synthesize gis.<city>tx.gov
Verify coverage by groupBy AND corner probes — never advertised extent alone
Exit-bounded requests only (curl --max-time 30; no pagination storms)
No atoms, no staging, no --apply, no store writes

source_catalogue.build_method: URLs and REST roots extracted from prior live probes and registry docs already in doc_repo; pinned statewide layers from T3 easement recon. Host list artifact: P:/tmp/l10_catalogue_hosts.json

statewide_and_clearinghouse.note: HIFLD/EIA Electric Power Transmission Lines named in _inbox/2026-08-01_public_data_layer_expansion_candidates.md as public statewide transmission — NOT distribution laterals. Probe via HIFLD open data catalogue search; do not invent a hostname. Treat as electric-transmission tier only.

bastrop_ground_truth_hosts.catalogue_origin: T3 easement / City of Bastrop AGOL org (CCN_Utility, Water layers previously named)

source_catalogue.host_synthesis_ban: If a principal city has no catalogue host above, do NOT invent one. Record NO_CATALOGUE_HOST and rely on statewide CCN + clearinghouse search for that jurisdiction.

sample_list.denominator: 28 launch-footprint counties from _decisions/2026-08-09_launch_footprint_counties.md + Bastrop as known ground
sample_list.principal_city_rule: County seat or largest incorporated place commonly treated as principal; sample probes the principal city PLUS any extra catalogue-hosted city in that county that is already in the municipal_rest_roots list (e.g. Williamson: Georgetown + Round Rock + Cedar Park).

rows.note: NO_CATALOGUE_HOST for municipal GIS — statewide CCN only
Denton proper may be NO_CATALOGUE_HOST if not in Z1 host list
Fort Worth proper: NO_CATALOGUE_HOST in Z1 layerUrl set — do not invent; Arlington/Burleson are catalogue-backed proxies in-county

per_source_steps: 1. ROOT LIST: GET {restRoot}?f=json (max-time 30). Folder-recurse one level if folders present (Deer Park class).

2. CANDIDATE ID: select layers by GEOMETRY TYPE (polyline/polygon) + FIELD SHAPE suggesting utility mains/CCN (diameter, material, CCN_NO, UTILITY, voltage) — never by name-regex alone. Name keywords water|sewer|wastewater|ccn|electric|power are HINTS only.
3. META: GET {layer}?f=json — record name, geometryType, fields, extent, maxRecordCount, capabilities.

5. GROUPBY VERIFY: query outStatistics groupByFieldsForStatistics on a county/utility field when present; else DISTINCT sample via returnDistinctValues on UTILITY or CCN_NO. Reject layers whose groupBy geography is outside the target county (UtahRoads class).

6. CORNER PROBE: query geometry=envelope of NW and SE corners of advertised extent (or county bbox), returnCountOnly. Both corners must return count consistent with coverage claim OR record EXTENT-MISMATCH.
7. SAMPLE ATTR: resultRecordCount=2 outFields=* returnGeometry=false — classify mains vs laterals vs territory vs unrelated.
8. STATUS: assign taxonomy string + one-line evidence. AUTH-WALLED liberally when 401/403/login redirect.
statewide_first: Probe PUCT Water CCN FeatureServer fully (groupBy COUNTY + corner probes across footprint).
Search PUCT download page / TNRIS for sewer CCN + electric territory siblings — record URLs only if discovered from those catalogue pages (no invented hosts).
Bastrop ground: enumerate city AGOL org + hub for Water / CCN / electric territory layers named in 2026-07-27 recon.

cp2_trigger: After statewide CCN + Bastrop ground + at least 8 footprint jurisdictions with municipal/county catalogue hosts probed for all three utilities.
do_not: Assume a utility rail or propose county_rail cells
Claim laterals when only mains or CCN found
Claim parcel serviceability from CCN territory alone without stating the letter-required residual
